_comment: Exact audit of production include_str!/include_bytes! sites and known hand-ports in the pinned inference revision. The digest is checked by check-license-coverage.mjs; any inference pin change forces a new audit. Tests/fixtures are outside this production inventory. Pin b7ef9254 advances inference main through the StarVector-8B resized tied-embedding vocabulary repair for both native MLX and Candle providers (PR #911). The exact scanner records 667 provenance candidates and 97 production-Rust crate prefixes at this pin. The scanner population and classifications are unchanged; no production path, marker classification, or crate-prefix population changed. Current report-only licensing findings must be read from the checker output; this summary does not freeze their counts or treat them as exceptions.

artifacts.evidence: CMUdict is third-party dictionary data; its complete BSD-2 notice is rendered by component cmudict.

provenanceScan.pathFilter: production .rs; exclude tests, testdata, benches, examples, and _vendor path segments
provenanceScan.markerRegex: faithful ... port(s), ported from, port(s) of, vendor(s)/vendored, transcribed, copied ... verbatim, adapted from, mirror(s|ed|ing) ... <port-object>, derived from ... <port-object>, reimplemented/reimplementation from|of, translated/transliterated from, from the reference (not reference-), original implementation|repo(sitory), based on ... <port-object>, follow(s|ing) ... <port-object>, reimplements ... <port-object>, rewrite of ... <port-object>, model(l)ed after ... <port-object>, ported to ... from, 1:1 with ... <port-object>, line-for-line ... <port-object> (case-insensitive; <port-object> = reference(not followed by -)|upstream|python|pytorch|torch|diffusers|comfy(ui)|transformers|implementation). `original` is NOT a bare port-object and `followed` is excluded: both produced verified false positives on first-party prose (sc-15191 review).
provenanceScan.normalization: matched marker text lowercased, internal whitespace collapsed, sorted, newline joined

BOTH JoyCaption prompt modules — the Candle lane's and its MLX twin — reproduce the caption-type taxonomy, prompt template bodies and name options from fpgaminer/joycaption's gradio-app/app.py (CAPTION_TYPE_MAP, NAME_OPTION), Apache-2.0. sc-15443 added byte-identical Apache Sec. 4(b) modification notices to both, which made them marker-bearing and is why they enter the inventory at this revision. Near-verbatim reproduced CONTENT, not an architectural port, so both carry the upstream licence rather than a crate-prefix architecture disposition. The MLX twin is named here rather than left to the `architecture:crates/media/mlx-gen` prefix area: sc-15191 left it to that prefix on the explicit ground that it carried no marker sentence and so could never enter the inventory, and sc-15443 retired that premise. The two files normalize to the same marker sha256, so splitting them across areas would have the inventory assert that identical notices carry different obligations.

NOT first-party: `src/prompt.rs` REPRODUCES upstream JoyCaption content, and that content IS licensed — Apache-2.0. Provenance chain re-verified 2026-07-27: the model card at https://huggingface.co/fancyfeast/llama-joycaption-beta-one-hf-llava (rev ebf414ea497a020da0f82df3913e5b6cb8e9663a) declares no `license:` in cardData but links https://github.com/fpgaminer/joycaption as the project source; that repository carries a root LICENSE = Apache License 2.0 (GitHub API `license.spdx_id: Apache-2.0`, and the fetched text carries the real copyright line `Copyright 2024 fpgaminer@bitcoin-mining.com`, not the unfilled template). The reproduced content lives in that repo at `gradio-app/app.py`, git blob d50843fab9dbe0a4389d1be33de7aae0260c85ff at commit 8445b2e55db7856d522e44ae84e7415fcf3413f6 (826 lines; `CAPTION_TYPE_MAP` at line 194, `NAME_OPTION` at line 256) — byte-identical to the same map the `fancyfeast/joy-caption-beta-one` Space serves at revision d0a1b8c39494884aa6ad4ff768189076ad054794. The 12 `CAPTION_TYPES` keys and the `PROMPT_TEMPLATES` bodies are upstream's `CAPTION_TYPE_MAP`, same entries in the same order, near-verbatim (punctuation normalized: em-dash to hyphen, curly to straight quotes, backticks dropped, `(if any)` to `, if any,`); the sole substantive SceneWorks MODIFICATION is in the Straightforward body, which folds upstream's `Note any watermarks, signatures, or compression artifacts.` into its `Never mention...` clause. `JOY_NAME_OPTION` is character-for-character upstream's `NAME_OPTION`. `CAPTION_LENGTHS` is upstream's length dropdown minus `very long`. `build_prompt` reproduces upstream's index-0/1/2 template selection, extra-option join, and {name}/{length}/{word_count} substitution with the `{NAME}` placeholder. `SYSTEM_PROMPT` is verbatim from the model card usage example. First-party here is only the capability bounds, the trigger-word post-processing, and the gen-core contract adaptation. Apache-2.0 §4 obligations: (a) the license text ships — the verbatim upstream LICENSE, copyright line included, is mapped as the `joycaption-source` About component (apps/desktop/licenses/joycaption-source/Apache-2.0.txt); (b) attribution is retained in that component (publisher fpgaminer, homepage github.com/fpgaminer/joycaption); (c) upstream ships NO NOTICE file, so §4(d) does not apply; (d) MODIFICATION MARKING was owed in the inference repo and is now SATISFIED — sc-15443 (inference `478d127f`) gave `src/prompt.rs` and the MLX sibling `crates/media/mlx-gen/src/caption/joycaption.rs` byte-identical module-header attribution/modification notices; it was tracked separately because inference is a separate repository (sc-15191 follow-up). Those notices are what make both files marker-bearing, so both are now named directly in this component's `paths` rather than the MLX sibling being covered indirectly via the `architecture:crates/media/mlx-gen` area. SEPARATE QUESTION, still open: the JoyCaption model WEIGHTS declare no license of their own — that remains in check-license-coverage.mjs's UNDETERMINED list and is NOT settled by this entry.
